envelope.description: Remove review runtime wiring from shared daemon services

body.title: Remove review runtime wiring from shared daemon services
body.summary: Detach ProductionReviews, dedicated workers/native/preparation/resource/cleanup owners, router/request ownership and live review progress producer registration. Preserve shared ThreadServices, worker hub/step state, process broker/providers and ordinary index/analyze/workflow task progress.
acceptanceChecks: Daemon startup/shutdown and normal requests allocate no review worker, runtime service, recovery scan, preparation or cleanup owner.
Shared ThreadServices, ordinary daemon worker routing, step state, provider broker and unrelated progress validation still function.
Historical review task rows remain inert/readable; no fabricated live or completed review progress is published.

tests.name: Daemon startup shutdown and dispatch create no review services workers progress producers or cleanup owners
Normal ThreadServices worker routing step state provider broker and task progress continue without review hooks
